AuthorityState.description: Whether a grant stood behind the action, as far as the record shows.
AuthorityState.title: AuthorityState

Decision.description: What the authority decided about the proposed action.
Decision.title: Decision

ExecutionState.description:
What happened to the action once authorised.

UNKNOWN is the honest answer for an action whose effect was never observed. A
dispatch acknowledgement is not execution and must not be reported as it.
ExecutionState.title: ExecutionState

GradeStatus.description: Which grade the issuer is reporting.
GradeStatus.title: GradeStatus

description: One governed action as a consumer sees it, at contract version 1.0.

case_id.description: Stable identifier for the governed action
case_id.title: Case Id

target.description: Provider or peer the action addresses
target.title: Target

proposal_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical proposal bytes; what the policy decided against
proposal_digest.title: Proposal Digest

decided_by.description: Enforcement point identity, never the acting agent
decided_by.title: Decided By

sealed_through_sequence.description: Last event sequence the sealed batch covers
sealed_through_sequence.title: Sealed Through Sequence

unsealed_tail_events.description: Events outside the sealed batch. Non-zero does not weaken the sealed grade
unsealed_tail_events.title: Unsealed Tail Events

provisional_grade.description: Issuer, before batch binding. Never final evidence
provisional_grade.title: Provisional Grade

achieved_evidence_grade.description: Issuer, for the sealed batch. Empty until a batch binding exists
achieved_evidence_grade.title: Achieved Evidence Grade

verified_grade.description: Relying party's verifier. Always empty from the issuer
verified_grade.title: Verified Grade

grade_scope.description: Boundary the grade describes, for example 'E2 @ sealed batch X'
grade_scope.title: Grade Scope

grade_cap_reason.description: Rung that stopped the ladder and the missing prerequisite, null when uncapped
grade_cap_reason.title: Grade Cap Reason

provider_operation_id.description: Provider-side identifier, when a provider was involved
provider_operation_id.title: Provider Operation Id
